config.status: candidate before final confirmatory freeze and any final-test scoring
config.representative_rule: Reuse the adjacent-calibration full-bundle representative rule with seed base plus source bucket. Sort exposures by bundle_index then immutable case_id before sampling one exposure per bundle.
config.origin_rule: Select uniformly within each user's test-role bundles before looking at future support or outcomes. Retain all selected origins in support denominators.
config.observed_cohort: H consecutive original timestamp bundles, including the origin, all within the same user's test role. No skipping excluded bundles or crossing user boundaries.
events: positive at least once through H
negative at least once through H
at least two positives through H
at least four positives through H
config.graph_transitions: 2*H-1 from a pending origin in the emission-aware decision lift
config.censoring_report: Selected, observed and unavailable origins and users, separately for every horizon and evaluation protocol. Do not count unavailable outcomes as negative.
config.weighting: Equal users within each supported observed-horizon cohort; report case-weighted descriptive sensitivity separately.
config.scope: Conditional recorded-response prediction under the logged exposure policy. No unconditional survival, intentional abandonment, causal intervention or arbitrary interface-transfer claim.
config.execution: Not run; final hashes, complete analysis and hardware/numeric policy must freeze before final-test scores. Secondary cohort design specified after early calibration-model compression diagnostics.

resource_budget.scope: Smoke/full timeout and startup reservations; not provider-enforced billing cap

buckets.scope: Outcome-blind test origins with complete available histories, private eventual-feedback targets, and explicit conditional observed-horizon support. No prediction scores, human confidence guarantee, unconditional survival or abandonment interpretation.
